mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not trend downward sufficiently over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, reflecting reduced labor market confidence and investment sentiment.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not cross the threshold as predicted.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both consumer demand (GDPC1) and business supply (INDPRO) signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise > 2% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or proxies do not exhibit the required upward movement.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing demand (HOUST) and business investment demand (RSAFS) indicates strong economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or proxies do not meet the specified increase.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in the industrial production index above 101.8926 signals robust supply-side activity, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO does not exceed the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% amplifies accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS does not trend downward sufficiently in the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of controlled inflation (CPIAUCSL below 3.0%) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable environment for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or proxies do not meet the specified conditions.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery phase, low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.0%) and rising labor demand (PAYEMS > 150000) signal improved employment conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or proxies do not exhibit the required movements in the regime.
